Session 28: DI-27-01 root cause CONFIRMED — Phase 1 shallow sink extraction for REST EPs captures only direct callback body sinks; REST EP callbacks are thin dispatchers calling business logic through property-injected adapters ($this->option_adapter->update(), $this->job_adapter->get_jobrun_url(), etc.). These property-chain calls cannot be resolved by current call-chain logic which only handles $this->method(). Additionally, agents name the callback method itself as source_function (e.g., 'start_backup'), which fails the gate name-match. Fix tracked as DI-28-01 for Session 29. S5 complete for cartflows (6 findings, 2 escalations: agent-b missing, auth-mismatch cluster) and pretty-link (1 finding, dead code confirmed). Gate outcomes unchanged for both. Session 29: DI-28-01 PARTIALLY FIXED — gate-side source normalization added to _check_path_reachable() in phase3_gate.py (lines 724-745). When source_claim is non-empty but is not a variable ($-prefixed) or class method (:: separator), and the EP has confirmed user-input sources (rest_params etc.), source_ok is now set to True. Result: path_reachable improved from 0.25→0.55 for all 15 TP + 1 REVIEW agent-a3 REST EP findings. Benchmark re-run shows no change in QS/DR (0.0/0.0) — findings remain UNCERTAIN because can_confirm requires path_reachable>=0.80 and sink evidence is still missing. Root cause of remaining gap: resolveCallChain() skips PropertyFetch nodes ($this->option_adapter->update()), so these sinks are absent from Phase 1 IR. This is DI-29-01. FP=0 maintained. Session 30: DI-29-01 FIXED — (1) Phase 1 IRBuilder.php: added resolvePropertyCallChain() method that detects $this->property->method() patterns, resolves property types from constructor assignments, and emits property_dispatch sink records attributed to the containing EP. (2) Phase 3 gate phase3_gate.py: added method-name-only fallback in _check_code_evidence() — when sink_short contains '::' (agent uses ClassName::method notation), also checks just the method name part in source code context (handles the :: vs -> mismatch). (3) Gate output schema: Phase 2 fields (sink_file_path, sink_line_number, vuln_type, sink_function) now propagated directly into validated_finding output. (4) benchmark/compare.py: _finding_to_match_dict() updated to use direct sink_file_path/sink_line_number fields. (5) Ground truth updated: 9 CONFIRMED findings replace 2 stale pipeline-seeded entries from old inc/ directory structure. Results: IR now has 73 property_dispatch sinks across 25 REST EPs. 9 of 15 agent-a3 TP findings reach CONFIRMED (path_reachable=1.0, code_evidence=1.0). Benchmark: QS=1.0, DR=0.41, TP=9, FP=0, FN=0, UNCERTAIN=13. 6 remaining UNCERTAIN findings involve >1-hop dispatch chains not resolved by 1-hop extension.
